summary: This report recommends amendments to the Supplier Code of Conduct of the Purchasing By-law based on consultation with the City's Broader Construction Association Consultation Group (the BCACG) to address concerns the BCACG has raised with a provision related to the City Treasurer's ability to disqualify a supplier in litigation or in debt with the City. In addition, other amendments are being recommended to provide additional clarity to provisions related to the responsibilities of Division Heads and Projects Lead as it relates to contract management, and the delegation for awards and for non-competitive contracts by Division Heads relates to delegated authority under the Financial Control By-law.
decided: City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the proposed revisions to Chapter 195, Purchasing, based on the summary set out in Attachment 1 to the report (February 5, 2018) from the Treasurer.
